verdict.rationale: Langfuse's managed LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators run inside the product on your production traces, producing AI-generated scores such as hallucination flags. That is a narrow form of AI-generated insight from your own data. However, nothing in the pack shows an in-product assistant that summarizes, explains or suggests improvements from your data. missing for 10: AI-generated natural-language insights or summaries over traces and metrics, AI-generated improvement suggestions (e.g. for prompts or fixes), any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Automatically score live production traces LLM-as-a-Judge
Production hallucination detection runs an LLM-as-a-judge evaluator on a sample of live traffic
LLM-as-a-Judge is an evaluation methodology where an LLM is used to assess the quality of outputs produced by another LLM application.
